Two things landed since M8 that your grammar has never been drawn against: R44's flat labelled membership credit (the count is frozen by operator decision - the screen must not imply it is about to move) and C28's per-bout purse rows, where the logistics debit is the fighter's own travel and a share never collectible is a present zero row. Boards to DesignLibrary/screens/books/m10_*, plus a rejects page. NO projection curve, no growth line, no member trend, no gym_cut, no bankruptcy state. Art only - Claude writes your HANDOFF block. Top tier, effort medium, Fast off.
